formal_definition: A_rec = { (C,R) : C subset C_rec^atom, 1 <= |C| <= 12, Phi_set(C) = 1, R in R_rec(C) }
R_rec: T_REC_V1 for every C (affine-linear in constructed coordinates, intercept allowed and not counted toward |C|, shared support identity, discharge-specific coefficients)

constraints.rule: no duplicate coordinate IDs in C
every coordinate in C belongs to C_rec^atom
C must NOT contain the COMPLETE membership of any frozen exact linear dependency group
constraints.note: a support may contain the aggregate and SOME components; it may not contain the aggregate and ALL eight component restatements in the same linear context. Neither form is privileged a priori.

constraints.rule: the target never appears in C

representation.why: the coordinate atoms together with the set-level predicates are a complete finite representation of A_rec. Enumerating every C is unnecessary and astronomically large.
representation.note: this count IGNORES Phi_dependency and is reported only to show why materialization was not attempted

explored_subset: S7.7 explores only a subset Ahat_rec

on_failure: record the representation as NOT_APPLICABLE on that discharge/block
external_partial_map_rule.outcome_decided_by: the downstream qualification stage, not S7.6

raw_baseline_nesting.true: primitive-only coordinate representations are nested within A_rec whenever their support size satisfies 1..12 and the set-level predicates
raw_baseline_nesting.not_claimed: B2 itself is necessarily a member of A_rec
raw_baseline_nesting.b2_description: the frozen raw Ridge comparator using the same admissible primitive information, potentially all 78 primitives
raw_baseline_nesting.fairness_claim: SAME INFORMATION BOUNDARY, not identical support-size constraint
